description: A users REST API: create, list, fetch, update and delete users.
behaviours: GET /v1/users lists users with cursor pagination (limit 1-100, default 20)
POST /v1/users creates a user, returns 201, honours Idempotency-Key, returns 409 when the email is already taken
GET /v1/users/:id returns the user or a 404 problem
PATCH /v1/users/:id updates name and/or role, returns 404 when missing, 422 on invalid input
Invalid input anywhere is a 422 application/problem+json
